[!dolt] skip
# Test bd graph renders dependency structure in dot and JSON forms
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Base task' --description 'Must go first' --json
extractid BASE
bd create 'Follow-up task' --description 'Depends on base' --json
extractid FOLLOW
bd dep add $FOLLOW $BASE

bd graph --dot $FOLLOW
stdout 'digraph'
stdout "$FOLLOW"
stdout "$BASE"

bd graph --json $FOLLOW
jq '.root.id'
stdout "$FOLLOW"
jq '.issues | length'
stdout '^2$'
